def transform(grid):
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] not in (0,))
    top = grid[:sep]
    bottom = grid[sep+1:]
    return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(r, s)] for r, s in zip(top, bottom)]
